value: **Involvement**: Teachers partnered with researchers in an iterative collaborative design process to conceptualize, author, and contextualize curricular materials and learning activities tailored to their classroom environments. **Evidence**: "Learning sequence: An educational intervention that employed activity trackers and offered students the opportunity to collect and critically consider data from their own physi cal activity, was designed by a co-design team, with input from collaborating teachers."
